notes:
What's new in 0.1.105:
- The "Secure media server: FAIL" box that could appear after an update is fixed. The start-up check was asking a page that sends you to the sign-in screen, and counted that as a failure. It now asks the server's health page. The cause was proven against a real server by a test. It has not yet been seen fixed by a person on an update.
- Picture frame: the screen can hide the clock and date or the note, show a note only when it is new (it stays until someone presses a big "Got it" button), keep a "Past notes" list on that screen only, put the clock and note in a small strip along the edge or in a corner box, show photos fitted with a soft blurred background, fitted, or filled, and go full screen with one button. The photo picker now finds photos you just copied in without pressing Refresh.
- The "It has been a week - try a direct connection" card now shows only on Home and Settings. It has a "Remind me in a week" button and gives a plain result line after "Try UPnP again".
- Library folders are watched. A film copied into a library folder appears by itself, usually about ten seconds after the copy finishes (up to a few minutes on a network drive). Rescan still works.
- Continue watching: a short replay of a film you already finished no longer hides your earlier part-watched row.
- The web page now shows your name in a small chip at the top right instead of a bare "Log out" button. It opens a "My profile" panel with your name, username, role, household, Account security and Log out.
- Podcasts: the computer can now show a podcast before it is followed (a new "preview" request), so a phone app that supports it can open a show from Find without following it. Older phone apps ignore it and nothing changes for them.
- Web player: the Left and Right arrow keys work again after Picture-in-Picture starts or closes, without clicking the video first.
- Web player: the "Resume from ...?" question now holds the film and stops saving your place until you answer, and "Reconnect" keeps your spot.
- Photos Map: the map is built when you turn the privacy option on (no more empty dark box), and if the map pictures cannot load the screen says so and still lists the photos that have a place.
- Camera backup: the computer now tells the owner's phone the PC name and the backup folder (read-only), so the phone app's Camera backup tab can show them. Nothing changes on this computer's screen.
- Diagnosis only, nothing changes in how things work: the log now has timing lines for the away-from-home connection and for slow video pieces and seeks, as well as the start-up timing lines from 0.1.104.
- Not fixed: the slow first minute after an update is not fixed, only logged. Chromecast TV captions and Samsung TV items are still being tested. The phone app and Beebo Auto are not in this release.
- Not in this release: the small screen fixes still waiting (Photos browser Back, plural wording, the Online chip, the Corner radius label), the TV Shows count and the folder-path privacy fix.
- Not yet checked: the library watcher has not been tried on a real mapped network drive, and the picture frame changes, the name chip, the Photos Map and the Resume question have not been tried by a person. Automated tests and reviews only; not yet tried by a person on an in-app update.
- Release source commit 71cd40519.
